evidence_policy: A deterministic/fixture pass proves the asserted property only. Provider quality, voice realism and rendered browser acceptance need separate live evidence.

cases.description: Anonymous access to ZERO is denied
Another signed-in user cannot retrieve a conversation
Two users retain independent locale and address preferences
An unsupported official locale is rejected explicitly
Model-dependent answer without a provider is reported as unavailable
Explicit user memory retains provenance and current owner
User memory is absent from another user's retrieval
Explicit deletion removes remembered content from retrieval
Read-only user cannot write organizational knowledge
Read-only discovery returns evidence states and uncertainty
Unconfigured models are explicitly distinguished from configured providers
Personal male/female and mode settings are retained
Preferences survive the actual encrypted server restart

additional_required_evidence: Real multi-turn cognition, social tone, humor and causal reasoning across eight locales
All nine modules and hard automotive/cross-module business tasks
Provider fallback, model quality, trace verification, cost and p50/p95/p99
Adversarial injection, poisoning, stale approvals, permission revocation and runaway prevention
Every user-facing surface across all eight locales
Male/female voice across all modes/locales with independent listening and interruption evidence
Full rendered browser, accessibility and responsive acceptance
Scenario-coherent automotive demo through production contracts
